messages:
kai-csm: Heads up  we have ~78 tenants affected by the onboarding embeddings delay; 14 are within 60 days of renewal. Proposing targeted outreach + short remediation slots + small credits. Thoughts?

olivia-cs: +1. Keep customer message very short and calm. Lead with 'No action required if search looks normal.' Offer 30-45m remediation and recorded replay.

morgan-eng: Root cause: replayed backfills during a scaled deploy caused ingestion lag. Mitigation in place; no data loss seen. Recommend advising customers NOT to re-run bulk reindex.

danielle-ops: Ops can host regional office hours next week. I'll create calendar links (PT/CET/APAC) and set auto-ticketing for any 1:1 requests.

kai-csm (draft): "Hi <Customer>,
We detected a temporary onboarding delay that may have affected embeddings for a subset of tenants. Engineers mitigated the issue; no data loss detected. If your search results look normal, no action required. If you see missing or mismatched results, schedule a short remediation slot here: <cal_link>. We are offering a small goodwill credit for impacted customers in renewal windows.
Thanks, Kai (Customer Success)"

olivia-cs: Add FAQ line: 'We do not recommend reindexing unless support advises.' Also include a tiny diagnostic snippet customers can paste.

morgan-eng: Diagnostic (single-line CURL): `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/<index>/count`

finance-bot: Finance pre-approved a credit banding framework (small/medium/large). CS to map to accounts and propose amounts.

danielle-ops: Action items: 1) kai finalize email + calendar by EOD; 2) olivia prepare localized short copy (EN/ES/FR) and recorded 30s clip; 3) morgan confirm diagnostic endpoint by tonight; 4) ops to tag renewal <60d for proactive 1:1s.

kai-csm: Aim to send first wave to <60d cohort 09:00 PT tomorrow. We'll capture a 2-question survey after sessions (resolved? yes/no; any follow-up?).

morgan-eng: I'll publish a short tech appendix link for customers who want details and sign off on wording by 22:00 PT.

olivia-cs: I'll prep the invite copy and survey, will ping when ready. :thumbsup:

status-bot: Incident ticket INC-ONBOARD-3123 created and linked to this thread.

kai-csm: Thanks team. Plan to monitor replies for urgent escalations and follow up with credit proposals in the post-wave thread.
